reference_sql:
SELECT s.order_line_id, s.product_id, s.order_date, s.units,
  CASE WHEN ol.promo_id IS NULL THEN 'full price' ELSE 'promo' END AS price_type
FROM sales s
JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_line_id = s.order_line_id
WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-03' AND DATE '2025-04-10'
  AND s.product_id IN (
    SELECT pp.product_id
    FROM promotion_products pp
    JOIN promotions p ON p.promo_id = pp.promo_id
    WHERE p.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-04-30'
  )
alternatives:
WITH spring_products AS (
  -- one row per product of a promotion that started in April 2025
  SELECT DISTINCT pp.product_id
  FROM promotion_products pp
  JOIN promotions p ON p.promo_id = pp.promo_id
  WHERE p.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-04-30'
)
SELECT s.order_line_id, s.product_id, s.order_date, s.units,
  CASE WHEN ol.promo_id IS NULL THEN 'full price' ELSE 'promo' END AS price_type
FROM sales s
JOIN spring_products sp ON sp.product_id = s.product_id
JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_line_id = s.order_line_id
WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-03' AND DATE '2025-04-10'

SELECT s.order_line_id, s.product_id, s.order_date, s.units,
  CASE WHEN ol.promo_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'promo' ELSE 'full price' END AS price_type
FROM sales s
JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_line_id = s.order_line_id
WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-03' AND DATE '2025-04-10'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM promotion_products pp
    JOIN promotions p ON p.promo_id = pp.promo_id
    WHERE pp.product_id = s.product_id
      AND p.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-04-30'
  )

  -- one row per product of a promotion that started in April 2025
  SELECT DISTINCT pp.product_id
  FROM promotion_products pp
  JOIN promotions p ON p.promo_id = pp.promo_id
  WHERE p.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-04-30'
)
SELECT s.order_line_id, s.product_id, s.order_date, s.units,
  CASE WHEN ol.promo_id IS NULL THEN 'full price' ELSE 'promo' END AS price_type
FROM sales s
JOIN spring_products sp ON sp.product_id = s.product_id
JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_line_id = s.order_line_id
WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-03' AND DATE '2025-04-10'
other_way.tradeoff: A CTE that lists the products once with DISTINCT works too; without DISTINCT, a product in two promotions repeats its lines.
